summary_1line: A Brahmana journeys to meet a Naga chief, waits fasting by the Gomati until the Naga returns from serving Surya.

image_candidates.scene_text: A solitary Brahmana sits in silent meditation on the banks of the Gomati, fasting beneath trees while groups of concerned Nagas gather around him.
The beautiful and dutiful wife of the absent Naga greets the Brahmana guest at the doorway of the serpent chief’s dwelling.
The Brahmana travels through serene forests and sacred lakes on his determined journey toward the hidden residence of the Naga chief.
